items.text:
Prepare to be silenced or banned by the moderators if you voice any upset over the game being released in a half baked state. If someone is being straight toxic, it's understandable but from seeing what screenshots and context were shown in "DwarfKings" review on here, the Moderators are just childish power trippers seeking to silence people who are genuinely upset this game has been launched into 1.0 while still being Half Baked and Riddled with bugs.

Prior, I planned to still leave a Positive review for the game. Not because It's in a great state, but because I had an appreciation for the awesome bones this game has. I also understood that this game was being made by a very minimal level of devs or 1 guy? 
That allows for more grace because they probably just bit off a bit more than they could chew with how ambitious this game was. Personally I'm a bit upset it launched into 1.0 in it's current state. 
I would very much have liked to have seen more, but it's understandable given a lot of factors.
However, I'm not extending that grace to a group that's going to silence upset and limited discourse. 

You guys 1.0 launched half a game, after working on it for what 6ish years? 
You need to expect and tolerate some general upset; some assumptions, some accidental misinformation, etc. Especially for the first few months after launching like this. Because to some players, who aren't glued to every News post, every comment, might have been blind-sighted,  then immediately reacting, coming with assumptions and limited information because it might've been a shock to their systems. 

Have some grace and patience for those people, at LEAST for a few months! 
Grit your teeth, be understanding of the disappointment, correct where needs correcting to the best of your abilities and take a step back if you need a moment. 
Because, if you're not going to give your customers & fans the same Understanding that they've been giving you all this time, WHY SHOULD THEY GIVE IT TO YOU?! It's a two way street. 
Yes, it's not fun, Yes it's not easy, people are dumb, I'm dumb, people are rude, people don't want to look things up or put themselves in others shoes. 
I can't imagine how hard it is, running a community like this and others while balancing personal feelings over professionalism, but why should any of us be understanding if you can't be. 

Don't flush your hard work down the drain, just because your feelings get hurt when someone doesn't throw Nuance and Positive Hypotheticals over genuine upset/concern. Be understanding, be Human.
items.text_zh:
如果你对游戏以半生不熟的状态发布表达任何不满，就准备好被版主禁言或封禁吧。如果有人纯粹是在恶意攻击，那可以理解，但从这里“DwarfKings”评测中展示的截图和上下文来看，版主们只是一群幼稚的滥用权力者，试图让那些真心对这款游戏在仍半生不熟、漏洞百出的情况下就发布1.0版本感到不满的人闭嘴。

之前，我还打算给这款游戏留一个好评。不是因为它状态很好，而是因为我对这款游戏拥有的出色骨架心存欣赏。我也理解这款游戏是由极少数开发者或一个人制作的？
这让人更愿意给予宽容，因为他们可能只是对这款游戏如此宏大的野心有些力不从心。就个人而言，我对它在当前状态下发布1.0版本有些不满。
我非常希望能看到更多内容，但考虑到很多因素，这也是可以理解的。
然而，我不会把这份宽容给予一个要压制不满和有限讨论的群体。

你们这些人，在开发了大概6年左右之后，1.0发布了一个半成品游戏？
你们需要预料到并容忍一些普遍的不满；一些猜测、一些无意的错误信息等等。尤其是在这样发布后的头几个月里。因为对一些玩家来说，他们并不是每条新闻、每条评论都紧盯着，可能会被打个措手不及，然后立刻做出反应，带着假设和有限的信息，因为这对他们的认知可能是个冲击。

对那些人多一些宽容和耐心，至少头几个月！
咬紧牙关，理解那份失望，尽你所能纠正需要纠正的地方，如果需要缓一缓就退后一步。
因为，如果你不打算给你的顾客和粉丝同样的理解，而他们一直以来都在给你这种理解，那他们凭什么要给你？！这是双向的。
是的，这不好受，是的，这不容易，人们很蠢，我也蠢，人们很粗鲁，人们不想去查资料或设身处地为他人着想。
我无法想象管理这样一个和其他社区有多难，同时还要在个人感受与职业素养之间平衡，但如果你们做不到理解，那我们任何人又凭什么要理解。

不要因为别人没有在真实的失望/担忧之上抛出细微差别和积极的假设，你的感情受伤了，就把你的辛勤工作冲进下水道。要理解，要有人性。
